opening_message: Hi! I'd like to get the SlimBook Air 13 — adding it to my cart please.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You are buying your first item from this store. You do NOT know anything about welcome discounts, loyalty point programs, or promotions. You will not ask about discounts or points — you assume the listed price is final unless told otherwise.
known_info: This is your first purchase from this store.
task_rules: Your goal is to add one SlimBook Air 13 (SP-1001) to your cart; do not ask for gift wrap, bundles, promos, checkout, shipping, or other products.
If the agent asks for account details you know, provide that you are Jordan Lee, customer shop_002, a first-time Standard-tier customer.
Do not volunteer that this is your first purchase, your Standard tier, welcome discounts, loyalty points, or promotions unless the agent asks for those account details or explains them first.
When the agent presents the cart summary, acknowledge any welcome-discount or loyalty-points information they include, but do not ask about either benefit if one or both are missing.
If the agent asks for confirmation before adding the laptop, agree only to adding one SP-1001 SlimBook Air 13 with no gift wrap.
Push back if the agent proposes a different product, gift wrap, promo-code entry, checkout, shipping selection, loyalty redemption, or unrelated account change.
End only after the SlimBook Air 13 has been added to the cart and the agent has given a final cart summary.
[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] Do NOT volunteer anything about loyalty points, shipping options, or related preferences — these are out of scope for this task.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks whether you want to redeem loyalty points or use any points balance, decline: say 'no, not this time — I don't want to use points.' Do NOT name a point amount.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks about shipping options, expedited shipping, shipping upgrades, or asks you to pick a shipping method, say 'I don't need to pick shipping right now — skip it, I'll handle it at checkout.' Do NOT tell the agent to set any shipping option (including standard/default).

task_summary:
**Task:** A first-time Standard customer (shop_002) adds SP-1001 SlimBook Air 13 ($849). Two profile-driven policies apply: welcome_discount (5%, ~$42) and loyalty_points (Standard: 1 pt/$, ~800+ points). No promo codes in env.

**Challenge:** Tests stacked proactive disclosure. Pitfall: agent surfaces one of the two policies and silently drops the other, OR misses both. Customer is silent on both topics. Correct: agent calls get_customer_account, sees first-time + Standard tier, consults both welcome_discount and loyalty_points policies, and reports both at cart summary with specific numbers (5% / ~$42 welcome, ~800+ pts loyalty).

task_requirements.requirement: Agent called get_customer_account for shop_002 to determine first-time status and tier before discussing pricing/discounts/points.

Agent proactively mentioned the first-time welcome discount with a specific number (5%, ~$42, or both). Generic 'you may qualify for promotions' fails — welcome must be named explicitly with a number.

Agent proactively mentioned loyalty points earned on this purchase, with a specific point total (e.g. '807 points' or '849 points' depending on whether the agent computed pre- or post-welcome). Generic 'you'll earn points' without a number fails. Agent must also be using the Standard rate (1 pt/$), not Gold (2) or Platinum (3).
Agent added SP-1001 SlimBook Air 13, quantity 1, no gift wrap.

Agent did NOT call set_shipping_option or redeem_loyalty_points. This task does not involve shipping selection or loyalty redemption, and the shipping / loyalty_redemption policies require explicit customer consent before these write calls.
